eps.t: ... but he never said he loved me
eps.d: Kate is determined that her past relationship with Michael is an obstacle to her remaining on the team.
Will Kate go to any lengths to get her own way on the anniversary of her cancelled wedding with Michael?
On the eve of the Founders' Ball, Rex and Diana's relationship takes a turn for the worse, causing trouble for the whole team.

eps.t: The Green Eye of the Little Yellow God
eps.d: A sinister visitor to the hospital seems determined to exploit everyone's personal weaknesses for his own ends.
Kate is horrified to discover that Diana has rented the Hospital Hall for a boxing match. But what can possibly change her mind?

eps.t: Beware Young Girls of Five and Twenty
eps.d: Phil's inept love life causes complications for Michael and Kate.
Michael and Kate are determined to help Phil Brooke celebrate his birthday by granting one of his wishes.
When Diana announces personality tests for all members of staff, Rex hatches a plot to get Kate out of his hair forever.

Michael lets his betting habits land him in considerable trouble with Kate. Meanwhile, the hospital is expecting a visit from Virginia Bottomley sending Diana Ewerts on a busy mission to tidy up both wards and patients alike. And Rex Regis has been thrown out of the house by his wife.
A free holiday will be Rex's if he can dispense enough of a dangerous drug to his patients.
Tensions between the staff of General and Surgical B surface on a training course.
Michael tries to allay fears of closure with a desperate plan.
